weather.title: Погода с Мультиком
weather.description: Daily weather programme at 10:00 Europe/Moscow, prepared from fresh forecast data immediately before transmission. Sixteen Russian cities; Open-Meteo is the fallback provider. If providers are unavailable, an explicitly labelled no-data card is used.

note: The continuous playlist repeats the channel's original educational programmes. The weather programme is excluded from that loop and airs once daily at 10:00 Europe/Moscow. The forecast is generated while the main programme remains on air, then switched into the live HLS stream. Weather uses MET Norway as the primary source, Open-Meteo as fallback, and wttr.in as a final fallback; if all are unavailable, the channel shows a clearly labelled no-data card.

maintenance.reference: Daily maintenance window aligned to Moscow broadcast time
